verdict.rationale: Skyvern's SDK connects to its cloud Chromium over CDP, layers Playwright on top, and offers AI commands "on top of Playwright" with fallback to selectors. That suggests existing Playwright-style code can run against Skyvern browsers. However, the evidence never documents exposing a CDP endpoint for bring-your-own Playwright or Puppeteer clients. Missing for 10: a documented CDP/WebSocket URL for connecting external automation code, Puppeteer support, migration docs for existing scripts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
